basics.name: Dr. Ákos Makra
basics.label: Test Automation Engineer · PhD in Information Science
basics.summary: Test automation engineer with about four years of testing experience and a PhD in Information Science. At Magyar Telekom I write and maintain automated system and E2E regression tests in Python, based on business requirements. Before that, I wrote unit and integration tests for dialysis machine software at B. Braun. My strengths are test design and making test suites reliable: I led the work that raised our regression pass rate from under 65% to over 95%.
basics.metaDescription: Dr. Ákos Makra — Test Automation Engineer with a PhD in Information Science. Python, Behave BDD, Playwright and Selenium regression automation at Magyar Telekom.

work.name: Magyar Telekom Nyrt.
work.summary: Writing and maintaining automated system and E2E regression tests in Python, based on business requirements.
responsibilities: Write and maintain automated system and E2E regression tests in Python (Behave, Playwright) from business requirements and acceptance criteria, following testing-pyramid principles.

Led regular team sessions over 9+ months to fix unstable regression tests. Pass rates went from under 65% to over 95% on two projects. Together with automating 30% of the manual regression test cases, this cut full regression on the largest project from 6 testers over 3–4 days to 3 testers in one day.

Refactor page objects, step definitions and helper code daily. Removed years of unused code from several repositories and added reusable functions to our shared Python API test library (Pydantic, OpenAPI).
Set up scheduled GitLab CI/CD pipelines; investigate failed runs using logs in Kibana and OpenSearch.
Escalated repeated test environment failures at 100 parallel threads, with evidence, until they were fixed. Regression could then run on 100 threads instead of 50.
Mentor manual testers in automation and log-based debugging. Interviewed multiple candidates for test automation roles.

work.name: B. Braun (via Effective Group Talent Solutions Kft.)
work.summary: Wrote automated unit and integration tests for safety-critical software on acute dialysis machines.
responsibilities: Wrote automated unit and integration tests in C and C++ (CppUTest) for safety-critical software on acute dialysis machines.
When the code or existing tests were unclear, checked the requirements in IBM DOORS and reported cases where the code did not match them.
